source: make the court like an nba court

image_prompt.text: The sideline and baseline perimeter of the court, built so play resets the moment the ball crosses it
The centre circle and free-throw positions play restarts from
Hoops and backboards at both baselines, each with the invisible scoring cylinder beneath the rim
the court laid out to regulation NBA proportions and markings

layout_placement.text: Out-of-bounds detection along the touchlines and baselines
Tip-off position at centre court and the two free-throw spots

notes: The prompt says the court, which refers back to a court from an earlier turn that this skill cannot see. Treated as a fresh build of a court.
Regulation court dimensions are a known fixed spec, so this should be placed parametrically rather than invented by the image model.
Nothing was said about the surrounding arena, so only the court itself is specified.

open_questions.ask: Just the court, or the whole arena around it - hardwood and bleachers, or an outdoor street court?
Is there an existing court in the build I should be matching to, or is this a new one?

coverage_missing.ask: Indoor hardwood arena, or outdoor street court?

answers.ask: Just the court, or the whole arena around it - hardwood and bleachers, or an outdoor street court?
answers.answer: Make it a compact indoor NBA-style arena court with hardwood flooring and simple bleachers around it.

answers.ask: Is there an existing court in the build I should be matching to, or is this a new one?
answers.answer: This is a new court; use a standard NBA-style full court layout.
